articles.title: The Measure That Stopped the Line
articles.text: In a packaging factory, a conveyor began to lag whenever a banana box reached the centre sensor. The supervisor resisted the temptation to treat the delay as bad luck and asked for a precise measurement of every box. With patience, a technician found that one label contained a grammatical error that made the scanner expect the wrong size. It was a pity to stop the line, but correcting the code was a cheap remedy that prevented a much larger breakdown.
articles.translation: 在一家包装厂里，每当香蕉箱到达中央传感器时，传送带就开始变慢。主管没有把延误当成倒霉，而是要求精确测量每个箱子。技术员耐心检查后发现，一张标签存在语法错误，导致扫描器预期了错误尺寸。停线很可惜，但修正代码是便宜的补救办法，并防止了更大的故障。

articles.title: Measuring Height Without Climbing
articles.text: A surveyor can estimate a big tower's height by comparing its shadow with the shadow of a pole of known length. This type of geometry once served military mapping, but students can test it with their own ruler, glove, or upright stick. The method does not command perfect weather; it needs clear sunlight and careful timing rather than equipment chosen for fashion, such as laser scissors. Openly sharing the calculation supports scientific justice, because anyone can examine it before the result is used in an export project.
articles.translation: 测量员可以把高塔的影子与已知长度杆子的影子比较，从而估算塔高。这种几何方法曾用于军事制图，但学生可以用自己的尺子、手套或直立木棍来测试。这种方法并不要求完美天气；它需要清晰阳光和准确计时，而不是激光剪刀之类时髦设备。公开计算过程有助于科学公正，因为结果用于出口项目之前，任何人都能检查。

articles.title: Export Growth Should Not Hide Waste
articles.text: During the first phase of an export boom, a factory deck may tremble under heavier machines while nearby families grow anxious about noise. A government grant can raise output to a new height, yet it should also fund cleaner geometry for workspaces and safer routes for trucks. Native plants may fade under dust, and workers may feel faint if factories consume air, water, and attention faster than they recover. Trade deserves support only when its visible profit includes the cost of protecting health and place.
articles.translation: 出口繁荣的第一阶段，厂房平台可能在更重的机器下震动，附近家庭则对噪声感到焦虑。政府补助可以把产量推到新高度，但也应资助更合理的工作空间布局和更安全的货车路线。本地植物可能因灰尘而衰败；如果生产消耗空气、水和注意力的速度超过恢复速度，工人也可能头晕。只有当可见利润包含保护健康与地方环境的成本时，贸易才值得支持。
